about: v7 short-film set (1 Nov 2026), written before any SHORTS result. A TUNING set (not sealed): used for the SHORTS rule (on >= off + 4 judge passes) and may be looked at. notes = what a good answer must do (the judge grades against them). If a short is not in the catalogue (python shorts.py coverage), the right answer says it does not have it rather than inventing.
